title: Sonic-AMG: Streaming Human Motion Generation from Spatial Audio
abstract: arXiv:2610.13300v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modeling human reactions to spatial audio requires understanding both what is heard and where it comes from. Prior work generates motion offline from complete acoustic and spatial input sequences. Humans, however, react to sounds without knowing what they will hear next. We present Sonic-AMG, to our knowledge the first framework for streaming human motion generation from spatial audio. The model encodes acoustic content and body-relative source geometry as separate tokens. Conditioned on these tokens, a causal transformer with a flow head generates continuous motion latents, from which a causal decoder reconstructs motion segments. Standard teacher-forced training derives motion histories and body-relative source locations from ground-truth motion, whereas streaming inference relies on generated motion for both, resulting in a training-inference mismatch. translated_title: Sonic-AMG：基于空间音频的流式人体动作生成
translated_abstract: 对空间音频建模人类反应需要同时理解所听到的内容以及声音的来源方位。先前的工作是基于完整的声学与空间输入序列离线生成动作。然而，人类是在不预知接下来会听到什么的情况下对声音做出反应的。我们提出Sonic-AMG，据我们所知，这是首个从空间音频进行流式人体动作生成的框架。该模型将声学内容与身体相对的声源几何信息编码为相互独立的标记。以这些标记为条件，一个带有流（flow）头的因果变换器生成连续的动作潜变量，再由一个因果解码器从中重建动作片段。标准的教师强制训练从真值动作中推导动作历史和身体相对的声源位置，而流式推理则依赖生成的动作来获得二者，从而造成训练与推理之间的不匹配。为减小这种历史差异，我们引入了排练训练，该方法将……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了首个从空间音频流式生成人体动作的框架Sonic-AMG，通过将声学内容与身体相对的声源几何信息分别编码为独立标记，由因果变换器生成动作潜变量，并引入排练训练来缓解训练与推理之间的历史不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: Sonic-AMG is the first framework for streaming human motion generation from spatial audio, which encodes acoustic content and body-relative source geometry as separate tokens, generates motion latents via a causal transformer with a flow head, and introduces rehearsal training to reduce the training-inference mismatch.
